svg.title: Enfilade Table with categories, grid and cell inspector
svg.desc: A data table with category filters, a formula bar, typed numeric cells, a selected range and a cell inspector.
svg.text: Typed cells, a visible formula bar and a selection that states its own extent. The grid is an editor, not a spreadsheet costume.
No empty cells in this column
A typed value stays a number. The
displayed format never becomes the stored
